subject: Compiler/fetch ready for integration:66+58+10 host cases pass, frozen hash
body:
Final compiler/fetch verification is complete on frozen host library SHA256 d6af7255cce8f4e9824a9190144a2627bde36a64e0dce1f688cae52038d174f2. New graphics specialization66/66; existing authored texture lowering58/58; existing tile suite10/10. Both new half2 arch9 XML oracle and existing vertex descriptor oracle pass ASan/UBSan. py_compile and scoped git diff --check pass. Evidence gpu/build/graphics-specialization-audit/{result.json,textures/result.json,tile/result.json}. No native build/device operations/commits.

Changed production files in this authorized increment: gpu/metal/tegu/mali_graphics_compiler.c/.h, vertex_fetch.c/.h. New tests: check_graphics_specialization.py, check_vertex_fetch_half2.py, vertex_fetch_half2_host_test.c. All three additive specialized exports are present. Legacy and explicit-default result bytes tested identical; changing constants specializes prior to linkage and reflects surviving resources. CPU tests do not claim GPU pixels or broad sampler support.

Cross-owner remaining work: compute AIR exact bound specialization sidecar and truthful sampler acceptance; render specialized-variant caching/call site, no nearest projection; air_bridge.rs and n2r format83 gates. TGP2 compiler enabling remains separate and disabled pending exact corrected manifest/domain ACK and transport readiness. Build lease is released as previously posted; parent owns integration/commits.
